{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Exclude refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
filtered_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rate_by_segment = filtered_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rate_by_segment.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rate_by_segment.max()

# Print results
print('Conversion rates by segment (percent):')
print(conversion_rate_by_segment)
print(f'Best segment: {best_segment} with {best_rate:.2f}%')"}
